defaultValue: When you hold more than one of something, the game normally draws its sprite once per unit, piled up behind the first one. These toggles make it draw a single sprite instead. The quantity number in the corner is untouched, so you can still see how many you have. Changes apply the next time a screen draws - no restart needed.

fieldDescription: Applies to weapons everywhere they are shown as a stack: the cargo screen, trading, storage, loot, and the weapon picker in refit.

fieldName: Crew and marines - one sprite only
fieldDescription: Crew and marine stacks pile up the same way, one extra portrait for every 50 aboard. Turn this on to flatten those too.
